turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: I have a pain here, in my stomach. Since yesterday.

turns.speaker: navi
turns.text: Okay, 말씀해 주셔서 감사합니다. Is the pain sharp, or more like a dull ache?

turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: Is it serious? What should I do?

turns.speaker: navi
turns.text: It is probably not serious, 하지만 확인하고 싶어요. Drink water, rest, and come back if the pain gets worse or 열이 나면요.
